description:
Firms registered in SAM.gov (public monthly extract) by certification, NAICS and state,
    including firms with few or no federal awards: for teaming and the rule of two. E.g. "SDVOSB
    firms in Virginia registered for 541512". Public registration fields only, no contacts.

certification.description: A certification or business type, e.g. "8(a)", "HUBZone", "SDVOSB", "WOSB", "EDWOSB", "VOSB", "small business".
certification.title: Certification

naics.description: An industry they registered for: NAICS code or words, e.g. "541512".
naics.title: Naics

name: find_registered_firms
title: Find SAM.gov-registered firms by certification
